output_list.reason: The mint function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The totalSupply is not checked against the TOKEN_LIMIT, allowing the totalSupply to overflow and become very large.

The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balances[msg.sender] is not checked to ensure it is greater than or equal to _value, allowing the balances to underflow and become very large.

The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balances[_from] is not checked to ensure it is greater than or equal to _value, allowing the balances to underflow and become very large.

The approve function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The allowed[msg.sender][_spender] is not checked to ensure it is greater than or equal to _value, allowing the allowed to underflow and become very large.

The increaseApproval function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The allowed[msg.sender][_spender] is not checked to ensure it is greater than or equal to _addedValue, allowing the allowed to underflow and become very large.

The decreaseApproval function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The allowed[msg.sender][_spender] is not checked to ensure it is greater than or equal to _subtractedValue, allowing the allowed to underflow and become very large.
